title: Specify radio-owned identity baseline
description: Record radio-owned-identity decision, make normal LCI messaging/UI ownership explicit, and mirror agent guidance. Changing attached phones does not transfer/regenerate the radio identity; independently provisioned radios have their own identities. User-facing key export/import is optional future work and deferred, not a new required capability. Preserve direct client IP access, initial provisioning and existing key-rotation rules.
acceptance_criteria: Decision ledger and LCI/agent guidance agree, no export/import API or automatic migration introduced, deferred feature recorded without arbitrary activation date. JSON/diff checks and independent focused documentary review pass.
close_reason: Radio-owned-identity decision, LCI Section17.1.2 and matching agent guidance added; no runtime or key-transfer changes. JSON uniqueness/decision checks, scoped diff check and explicit deferred-status check passed. Independent focused documentary review found no issues.
